results.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
results.content: We propose Low-Rank Adaptation, or LoRA, which freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture, greatly reducing the number of trainable parameters for downstream tasks.

results.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
results.content: We present QLoRA, an efficient finetuning approach that reduces memory usage enough to finetune a 65B parameter model on a single 48GB GPU while preserving full 16-bit finetuning task performance.

results.title: LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less
results.content: We compare the performance of LoRA and full finetuning on two target domains, programming and mathematics, and find that LoRA substantially underperforms full finetuning in most settings.
